escalation_note: 11 crops at 900 dpi. ⚠ FOUR OF THEM WERE WASTED ON A TOOLING TRAP THAT IS ITSELF THE MAIN FINDING OF THIS FILING, recorded here as precedent: pages 2 and 3 of this PDF carry **/Rotate 270** (pdfinfo: 612x792 pts, rot 270), so poppler renders them LANDSCAPE 2200x1700 while scripts/campaign_finance/make_snippet.py computes its pct box against the UNROTATED 612x792 MediaBox. The two coordinate systems therefore disagree by the aspect swap (render_x% = mediabox_x% x 8.5/11), and a make_snippet crop of the Amount column returned the Address column instead. Worse, the right ~23% of a rotated page is UNREACHABLE through make_snippet at all: the Amount band here starts at render x 85.23%, which would need mediabox x 110% > 100. The wave contract says pct is 'always of the page AS POPPLER RENDERS IT (rotation included)', so THIS RECORD STORES RENDER-SPACE PCT as required — but nobody should expect make_snippet to resolve it on these two pages until that script learns about /Rotate. It is shared and frozen this phase, so it was NOT touched; the seven verification crops were taken with a scratchpad pdftoppm+PIL cropper that works in render space, and they reproduced $53,000.00 / $500.00 / empty on p2 rows 1/6/7 and $931.39 / $17,000.00 / $300.00 / empty on p3 rows 1/8/14/15.
